$comment: Stand-in opponents for when there is no card art: one per mana colour (W U B R G C), a regular and a boss. Replaces the drawn Portrait in ModeArt.tsx.
style: Opponent portraits: head-and-shoulders bust of one duelist per cell as an ivory pictogram facing the viewer, cut off with a clean straight edge at the bottom of the chest. A second ink is allowed for ONE flat area (a cloak, a sash, a crest on the armour) in the accent named by the subject. Bosses wear an unmistakable crown, horns or great helm. Head and shoulders fill the cell.
spare: a hooded traveller, accent ink none
